hints.title: Diagonal Coordinate Identification
hints.text: For an n x n matrix, the main diagonal elements are nums[i][i] and the anti-diagonal elements are nums[i][n - 1 - i].

hints.title: Primality Test Check
hints.text: A number x <= 1 is not prime. Otherwise, check divisibility up to integer square root of x.

hints.title: Maximum Prime Retention
hints.text: Inspect all diagonal values and maintain the maximum value that satisfies primality.

hints.title: Diagonal Primality Check Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing at most 2n values each taking O(sqrt(M)) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all n^2 elements instead of only diagonal elements is redundant.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Inspects both main and anti-diagonals with standard primality test.
